title: Support forward and back navigation when appropriate

statement.en: Ensure the experience accommodates forward and back navigation when appropriate.
statement.ja: forward and back navigation when appropriateを利用できる設計にする。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Web views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるWeb viewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Ensure the experience accommodates forward and back navigation when appropriate.” in the documented Web views context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Ensure the experience accommodates forward and back navigation when appropriate.

apple_native_rule: Ensure the experience accommodates forward and back navigation when appropriate.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Avoid using a web view to build a web browser

statement.en: Exclude using a web view to build a web browser from the applicable experience.
statement.ja: 該当する体験ではusing a web view to build a web browserを避ける。
